_comment: Rytivo curated supplement (proprietary). Exercises missing from free-exercise-db, written for Rytivo. Required: name, category, equipment, primary_muscles, level, instructions (3-6 steps). Optional: aliases, secondary_muscles, movement_pattern, mechanic, force, disciplines, family (derived by rules when omitted). The slug is always derived from the name.

exercises.name: Wall Ball
instructions: Stand an arm's length from a wall with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a medicine ball at chest height with your elbows under the ball.
Keep your chest up and squat until your hips drop below your knees.
Drive out of the squat and use that momentum to press and throw the ball to a target on the wall above you.
Catch the ball as it falls, absorbing it at your chest as you descend straight into the next squat.

exercises.name: Thruster (Barbell)
instructions: Hold a barbell in the front rack position, resting on your shoulders with your elbows high and hands just outside shoulder width.
Brace your core and squat down, keeping your elbows up and your torso upright.
Drive up out of the bottom of the squat as fast as you can.
Use the momentum from your hips to press the bar overhead in one continuous motion, finishing with your arms locked out.
Lower the bar back to the front rack and flow into the next rep.

exercises.name: Thruster (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders with your palms facing each other.
Squat down until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, keeping your chest tall.
Stand up explosively and press the dumbbells overhead as your hips reach full extension.
Bring the dumbbells back to your shoulders and go straight into the next squat.

exercises.name: Single Arm Thruster (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold one dumbbell at your shoulder with your other arm out to the side for balance.
Squat down while keeping your torso upright and resisting any lean toward the dumbbell.
Drive up and press the dumbbell overhead as you stand.
Return it to the shoulder, finish the set, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Double Under
instructions: Hold the jump rope handles at hip height with your elbows close to your sides.
Jump slightly higher than a normal skip, staying on the balls of your feet with your legs nearly straight.
Spin the rope with fast wrist turns so it passes under your feet twice before you land.
Land softly and keep a steady rhythm from one jump to the next.

exercises.name: Burpee
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor and jump or step your feet back into a plank.
Lower your chest to the floor, then push back up.
Jump or step your feet back toward your hands.
Stand up and finish with a small jump, clapping your hands overhead.

exercises.name: Bar Facing Burpee
instructions: Stand facing a barbell on the floor, parallel to it, with your toes close to the bar.
Drop into a burpee, bringing your chest to the floor with the bar in front of you.
Push up and bring your feet back under you while staying square to the bar.
Jump over the bar with both feet taking off and landing together.
Turn to face the bar again and go into the next rep.

exercises.name: Burpee Pull Up
instructions: Stand under a pull-up bar that you can reach with a small jump.
Perform a burpee, bringing your chest to the floor and returning to your feet.
Jump to grab the bar and pull your chin over it.
Lower yourself under control, drop back to the floor and begin the next rep.

exercises.name: Burpee Box Jump Over
instructions: Stand facing a plyo box at a comfortable distance.
Perform a burpee, touching your chest to the floor.
Return to your feet and jump onto the box, or over it, landing with soft knees.
Step or jump down the far side, turn around and repeat.

exercises.name: Burpee Broad Jump
instructions: Perform a burpee, bringing your chest to the floor and returning to a squat.
Swing your arms back, then drive them forward as you jump as far forward as you can.
Land on both feet with your knees bent to absorb the impact.
Go straight into the next burpee where you landed.

exercises.name: Box Jump Over
instructions: Stand facing a box with your feet hip-width apart.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump onto the box, or clear it completely, landing softly with both feet.
Step or hop off the far side, turn around and repeat in the other direction.

exercises.name: Toes to Bar
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Engage your lats by pressing the bar down toward your hips and tighten your core.
Raise your legs, keeping them as straight as you can, until your toes touch the bar between your hands.
Lower your legs under control, using the swing to set up the next rep if you are kipping.

exercises.name: Knees to Elbow
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and your body still.
Pull your shoulders down and brace your core.
Drive your knees up and curl your hips until your knees touch your elbows.
Lower your legs with control back to a full hang.

exercises.name: Kipping Pull Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than your shoulders.
Start a controlled swing by pushing your chest through your arms (arch) and then pulling your legs forward (hollow).
At the end of the hollow, drive your hips up and pull hard with your arms to get your chin over the bar.
Push away from the bar as you come down to return to the arch and link the next rep.

exercises.name: Butterfly Pull Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip and build a small hollow-to-arch swing.
Pull your chin over the bar while driving your hips slightly forward and up.
Instead of dropping straight down, let your body travel forward and down in a circular path.
Use the bottom of the circle to swing back into the next pull without pausing.
Build up to this with strict and kipping pull-ups first, since the cycling rhythm loads the shoulders quickly.

exercises.name: Chest to Bar Pull Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip a little wider than your shoulders.
Pull, strict or with a kip, and keep driving your elbows down and back.
Finish with your chest touching the bar just below your collarbones.
Lower back to a full hang before the next rep.

exercises.name: Bar Muscle Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip at about shoulder width.
Build a strong hollow-to-arch swing, then snap your hips toward the bar as you pull explosively.
As your chest reaches the bar, lean your shoulders over it and turn your wrists so you are on top of the bar.
Press down into a straight-arm support above the bar.
Lower yourself under control back to a hang.

exercises.name: Kipping Handstand Push Up
instructions: Kick up into a handstand facing away from a wall with your hands slightly wider than your shoulders and a mat under your head.
Lower your head to the mat under control.
Bring your knees toward your chest, then kick your legs up hard against the wall.
Press through your arms at the same moment so you finish with your elbows locked.
Learn strict handstand push-ups first and keep the descent controlled to protect your neck.

exercises.name: Pike Push Up
instructions: Start in a push-up position, then walk your feet in and lift your hips so your body forms an upside-down V.
Place your hands slightly wider than your shoulders and keep your legs as straight as you comfortably can.
Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head toward the floor just in front of your hands.
Press back up to straight arms, keeping your hips high throughout.

exercises.name: Wall Walk
instructions: Lie face down with your feet against the base of a wall and your hands next to your chest.
Push up into a plank, then place your feet on the wall.
Walk your feet up the wall while walking your hands back toward it, keeping your body tight.
Stop when your chest is close to the wall in a handstand, then reverse the steps to come down slowly.

exercises.name: Handstand Walk
instructions: Kick up into a handstand with your hands shoulder-width apart and your fingers spread.
Squeeze your legs together and keep your ribs down so your body stays in a straight line.
Shift your weight onto one hand and take a small step forward with the other.
Keep taking short, quick steps, letting your hips lead slightly so you stay balanced.
Come down by stepping one foot to the floor when you lose balance or finish the distance.

exercises.name: Handstand Hold
instructions: Place your hands shoulder-width apart about a hand's length from a wall.
Kick up one leg at a time until your heels rest lightly on the wall.
Push the floor away so your shoulders reach toward your ears, and squeeze your glutes and legs.
Hold the position while breathing steadily, then step down one leg at a time.

exercises.name: Legless Rope Climb
instructions: Sit or stand below the rope and grab it with both hands as high as you can reach.
Pull yourself up using only your arms, keeping your legs still or in an L-sit.
Reach one hand above the other, gripping hard each time before you move the next hand.
Climb down hand under hand under control; never slide down the rope.

exercises.name: Devil Press (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand over two dumbbells placed on the floor just outside your feet.
Place your hands on the dumbbells, jump back into a plank and lower your chest to the floor.
Push up and jump your feet back toward the dumbbells into a deadlift stance.
Hinge and swing both dumbbells back between your legs, then drive your hips forward to bring them overhead in one motion.
Lower the dumbbells back to the floor and repeat.

exercises.name: Man Maker (Dumbbell)
instructions: Start in a plank with your hands on two dumbbells.
Do a push-up, then row one dumbbell to your hip and then the other while keeping your hips level.
Jump your feet in toward the dumbbells.
Clean the dumbbells to your shoulders and squat, then stand and press them overhead.
Lower the dumbbells to the floor and return to the plank for the next rep.

exercises.name: Sled Rope Pull
instructions: Attach a long rope to a loaded sled and walk out until the rope is taut.
Stand or sit in an athletic stance facing the sled with a slight bend in your knees.
Pull the rope toward you hand over hand, keeping your chest up and your back flat.
Keep pulling until the sled reaches you, then walk it back out for the next set.

exercises.name: Sandbag Carry
instructions: Squat down and wrap your arms around a sandbag, pulling it tight to your chest.
Stand up by driving through your legs while keeping your back as flat as you can.
Walk forward with short, controlled steps, keeping the bag high and your core braced.
Set the bag down by squatting with it, rather than dropping it from height.

exercises.name: Sandbag Clean
instructions: Stand over a sandbag with your feet hip-width apart and grip it on the sides or the handles.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and lift the bag to your lap.
Drive your hips forward explosively and pull the bag up as you drop slightly under it.
Catch the bag across your forearms at chest height, then stand tall.
Lower the bag back to the floor under control.

exercises.name: Sandbag to Shoulder
instructions: Straddle a sandbag and grab it with your arms wrapped around it.
Lift it to your lap by sitting back with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward hard and pull the bag up and onto one shoulder, turning your head away from it.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bag to the floor and alternate shoulders on each rep.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Stand with your feet a little wider than your hips with a kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge at the hips, grab the handle with both hands and hike the bell back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and squeeze your glutes so the bell floats up to chest height with straight arms.
Let the bell fall back, hinge again as it passes between your legs, and repeat.
Keep your back flat and let the power come from your hips, not your arms.

exercises.name: American Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Set up as for a kettlebell swing, holding the handle with both hands.
Hike the bell between your legs and drive your hips through powerfully.
Keep guiding the bell upward until it is directly overhead with the bottom pointing at the ceiling and your arms by your ears.
Control the descent, hinge as the bell passes between your legs and repeat.
Use a lighter bell than for Russian swings and avoid arching your lower back at the top.

exercises.name: Cluster (Barbell)
instructions: Set up over the bar as for a clean, with a flat back and the bar over the middle of your feet.
Pull the bar from the floor and receive it in a full front squat.
Without pausing at the top, drive out of the squat.
Use that drive to press the bar overhead as you would in a thruster.
Lower the bar to your shoulders, then to the floor, and reset for the next rep.

exercises.name: GHD Sit Up
instructions: Sit on a glute ham developer with your feet locked under the pads and your hips just off the back of the seat.
Lean back with control until your torso is parallel to the floor or your hands reach the floor behind you.
Kick your knees straight and sit up quickly, reaching toward the footplate.
Start with a small range of motion and low volume; this movement can leave your abs and hip flexors very sore.

exercises.name: Ski Erg
instructions: Stand facing the ski erg and take one handle in each hand with your arms extended overhead.
Pull the handles down in an arc, hinging at the hips and bending your knees slightly as your hands pass your thighs.
Return to standing tall as the handles travel back up.
Keep a steady rhythm and set the damper and pace for your workout, tracking time, distance or calories.

exercises.name: Air Bike
instructions: Adjust the seat so your leg is almost straight at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
Grip the moving handles and place your feet on the pedals.
Pedal while pushing and pulling the handles, using your arms and legs together.
Work at the pace your session calls for; resistance rises the harder you push, so start steady.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift High Pull (Barbell)
instructions: Take a wide stance with your toes turned out and grip the bar with a narrow overhand grip inside your knees.
Lift the bar by driving through your legs with a flat back.
As the bar passes your knees, extend your hips explosively and shrug.
Pull the bar up to just under your chin, leading with your elbows high and outside the bar.
Lower the bar to your hips, then to the floor, in a controlled path.

exercises.name: Single Arm Snatch (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell on the floor between your feet.
Squat down with a flat back and grab the dumbbell with one hand.
Drive through your legs and hips explosively, keeping the dumbbell close to your body as it rises.
Punch it overhead and catch it with your arm locked, then stand tall.
Lower the dumbbell to the floor and switch hands as required.

exercises.name: Hang Power Snatch (Barbell)
instructions: Stand holding the bar at your hips with a wide snatch grip.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down to just above your knees, keeping your shoulders over the bar.
Extend your hips and knees explosively and shrug, keeping the bar close.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it overhead in a partial squat with locked arms.
Stand up fully, then lower the bar to your hips for the next rep.

exercises.name: Hang Power Clean (Barbell)
instructions: Stand holding the bar at your hips with a grip just outside shoulder width.
Hinge to lower the bar to just above your knees with a flat back.
Jump the bar up by extending your hips and knees, then shrug.
Pull your elbows around quickly and catch the bar on your shoulders in a partial squat.
Stand up, then return the bar to the hang position.

exercises.name: Jumping Jack
instructions: Stand with your feet together and your arms at your sides.
Jump your feet out wider than your hips while swinging your arms up overhead.
Jump your feet back together as you lower your arms.
Keep a steady, light rhythm on the balls of your feet.

exercises.name: High Knee
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Run in place, driving one knee up to hip height while you stay on the ball of the other foot.
Switch legs quickly, pumping your arms in rhythm with your legs.
Keep your torso upright and land lightly.

exercises.name: Bear Crawl
instructions: Start on your hands and knees, then lift your knees an inch or two off the floor.
Keep your back flat and your hips level with your shoulders.
Move forward by stepping one hand and the opposite foot at the same time.
Take small steps and keep your knees low throughout the distance.

exercises.name: Crab Walk
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent, feet flat and hands behind you with fingers pointing toward your feet.
Lift your hips off the floor so your weight is on your hands and feet.
Walk forward or backward by moving one hand and the opposite foot together.
Keep your hips lifted the whole time.

exercises.name: Shuttle Run
instructions: Mark two lines a set distance apart, such as 10 to 20 meters.
Sprint from the first line to the second.
Plant your outside foot, touch the line with your hand and change direction.
Sprint back and continue for the set number of lengths.

exercises.name: Sprint
instructions: Warm up thoroughly with easy running and drills before sprinting.
Start from a staggered stance with your weight slightly forward.
Drive your arms hard and push the ground behind you, building to top speed over the first few steps.
Run the set distance at maximal effort, then walk back to recover fully before the next rep.

exercises.name: Running
instructions: Start with a few minutes of brisk walking or easy jogging to warm up.
Run with a tall posture, relaxed shoulders and your arms swinging forward and back.
Land with your foot close to under your hips and keep a quick, light cadence.
Hold a pace you can sustain for the planned time or distance, then cool down with easy walking.

exercises.name: Walking
instructions: Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and your gaze ahead.
Walk at a comfortable pace, rolling from heel to toe on each step.
Swing your arms naturally and pick up the pace if you want a brisker effort.
Keep going for the planned time or distance and slow down for the last few minutes.

exercises.name: Swimming
instructions: Warm up with a few easy lengths in any stroke.
Swim your chosen stroke with a long body position and steady breathing.
Work through the planned number of lengths or time, resting at the wall as needed.
Finish with an easy cool-down length.

exercises.name: Front Lever
instructions: Hang from a bar or rings with an overhand grip and straight arms.
Press the bar down toward your hips with straight arms while you lean back.
Raise your body until it is horizontal and face-up, with your legs together and your hips extended.
Hold the position with your shoulders depressed and your core tight, then lower your legs under control.

exercises.name: Tuck Front Lever
instructions: Hang from a bar with straight arms and tuck your knees tightly to your chest.
Pull the bar toward your hips with straight arms so your back rotates up toward horizontal.
Hold your back parallel to the floor with your knees tucked and your shoulders pulled down.
Lower out of the hold slowly and rest before the next attempt.

exercises.name: Front Lever Raise
instructions: Hang from the bar with straight arms and your body tight.
Keeping your arms locked, raise your whole body as one unit up through the horizontal lever position.
Continue until your hips are near the bar if you can, or stop at horizontal.
Lower slowly back to a dead hang. Use a tuck or one leg bent to make it easier.

exercises.name: Back Lever
instructions: From a hang on rings or a bar, tuck your legs and rotate backward through skin the cat until you are inverted with your back facing the floor.
Extend your body slowly until it is horizontal and face-down, with your arms straight.
Squeeze your glutes and keep your body in one straight line.
Hold, then return by tucking and rotating back the way you came. Build up with tuck and straddle versions.

exercises.name: Tuck Back Lever
instructions: Hang from rings or a bar and tuck your knees to your chest.
Rotate backward until your back faces the floor and your hips are level with your shoulders.
Keep your arms straight and your knees tucked, holding the position.
Rotate back up and out of the hold under control.

exercises.name: Planche
instructions: Place your hands on the floor or parallettes about shoulder-width apart with your fingers turned slightly out.
Lean your shoulders well forward past your hands with your arms locked straight.
Push the floor away and lift your feet so your whole body hovers parallel to the floor.
Hold with your legs together and your body straight, then lower your feet with control.
Work through tuck, advanced tuck and straddle versions before attempting the full planche.

exercises.name: Tuck Planche
instructions: Squat down and place your hands on the floor or parallettes just in front of your feet.
Lean forward over your straight arms and tuck your knees tightly toward your chest.
Push the floor away and lift your feet so you balance on your hands with a rounded back.
Hold with your arms locked, then set your feet down gently.

exercises.name: Advanced Tuck Planche
instructions: Begin in a tuck planche with your arms straight and your shoulders leaning forward.
Open your hips so your back becomes flat and parallel to the floor while your knees stay bent.
Hold your hips level with your shoulders and keep pushing the floor away.
Lower back to the tuck or to your feet with control.

exercises.name: Straddle Planche
instructions: Start from an advanced tuck planche with your arms locked.
Extend your legs out wide to the sides while keeping your body parallel to the floor.
Squeeze your glutes and point your toes to keep your hips from sagging.
Hold, then bring your legs back into a tuck before lowering.

exercises.name: Planche Lean
instructions: Get into a push-up position with your fingers turned slightly outward.
Keep your arms straight and shift your shoulders forward past your hands, coming onto your toes.
Round your upper back slightly and keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Hold the lean, then shift back. Lean further over time as your wrists and shoulders adapt.

exercises.name: L-Sit
instructions: Sit between parallettes, dip bars or two sturdy boxes and place your hands beside your hips.
Press down to straighten your arms and lift your hips off the floor.
Raise your legs straight out in front of you until they are parallel to the floor.
Hold with your shoulders pushed down and your toes pointed. Bend your knees to make it easier.

exercises.name: V-Sit
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Lean back slightly and lift your feet so you balance on your sit bones.
Straighten your legs and reach your arms forward, forming a V shape with your body.
Keep your chest lifted and your back long while you hold, breathing steadily.

exercises.name: V-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your arms extended overhead.
Brace your core and lift your arms, head, shoulders and legs off the floor at the same time.
Reach your hands toward your feet so your body forms a V at the top.
Lower back down slowly without letting your lower back arch off the floor.

exercises.name: Human Flag
instructions: Grip a vertical pole with both hands, the top hand overhand and the bottom hand underhand, well more than shoulder-width apart.
Push hard with your bottom arm and pull with your top arm, keeping both arms straight.
Kick your legs up to the side until your body is horizontal, or as close as you can manage.
Hold with your body tight, then lower your legs under control.
Build up with tuck and straddle versions before the full flag.

exercises.name: Pistol Squat
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other leg held straight out in front of you.
Reach your arms forward for balance and lower yourself by bending your standing knee and hip.
Go as deep as you can control, ideally until your hamstring rests on your calf, keeping your heel down.
Drive back up to standing without letting your knee cave inward. Hold a support or squat to a box to make it easier.

exercises.name: Shrimp Squat
instructions: Stand on one leg and bend the other knee, holding that foot behind you with the same-side hand.
Lean your torso slightly forward and lower yourself on the standing leg.
Descend until your back knee lightly touches the floor.
Push through your standing foot to return to the top. Hold a support for balance if needed.

exercises.name: Dragon Flag
instructions: Lie on a bench and grip it behind your head.
Roll your weight onto your upper back and raise your legs and hips until your body points up.
Keeping your body straight from shoulders to toes, lower it slowly toward the bench.
Stop just above the bench and raise back up, pivoting at the shoulders rather than bending at the hips.

exercises.name: Archer Push Up
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands placed much wider than your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward one hand, bending that elbow while the other arm stays straight.
Push back up to the middle.
Alternate sides, or complete all reps on one side before switching.

exercises.name: Archer Pull Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with a very wide overhand grip.
Pull yourself up toward one hand, bending that arm while the other arm straightens out along the bar.
Get your chin above the bar on the working side.
Lower under control and alternate sides.

exercises.name: Pseudo Planche Push Up
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands beside your waist and your fingers turned out or back.
Lean your shoulders forward past your hands and keep your body straight.
Lower your chest toward the floor while keeping the forward lean.
Press back up, keeping your shoulders in front of your hands throughout.

exercises.name: Ring Row
instructions: Set the rings around waist height and grab one in each hand.
Walk your feet forward and lean back until your arms are straight and your body is in a straight line.
Pull your chest up to the rings, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower yourself slowly. Walk your feet further forward to make it harder.

exercises.name: Ring Push Up
instructions: Set the rings a few inches off the floor and hold them with your arms straight in a push-up position.
Keep the rings close to your sides and your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest between the rings while stopping them from drifting outward.
Press back up and turn your palms slightly forward at the top.

exercises.name: Skin the Cat
instructions: Hang from rings or a bar with straight arms.
Tuck your knees and lift your legs up and over, rotating backward between your arms.
Lower your legs toward the floor behind you as far as your shoulders comfortably allow.
Pause, then reverse the movement to return to a hang. Go only as deep as you can control.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms overhead and your legs straight.
Press your lower back into the floor and lift your shoulders, arms and legs a few inches up.
Keep your ribs down and your body shaped like a shallow banana.
Hold while breathing steadily. Bend your knees or bring your arms to your sides to make it easier.

exercises.name: Hollow Rock
instructions: Get into a hollow body hold with your lower back pressed into the floor.
Keeping the shape fixed, rock backward onto your upper back.
Rock forward onto your hips and lower back, still holding the same shape.
Continue rocking smoothly without letting your arms or legs drop.

exercises.name: Typewriter Pull Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with a wide overhand grip.
Pull yourself up until your chin is over the bar in the middle.
Shift across toward one hand, straightening the other arm, while staying at bar height.
Slide across to the other hand, return to the middle and lower yourself under control.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Stand about two feet in front of a bench and rest the top of your back foot on it.
Keep your torso upright and your front foot flat on the floor.
Lower your back knee toward the floor by bending your front knee until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Push through your front heel to stand back up. Complete your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Split Squat
instructions: Take a long step forward so your feet are in a split stance, about hip-width apart side to side.
Keep your torso tall and lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Push through your front foot to rise back up without moving your feet.
Finish your reps on one side, then switch.

exercises.name: Lunge
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step forward with one leg and lower your hips until both knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Keep your front knee over your foot and your torso upright.
Push off your front foot to return to standing, then repeat on the other leg.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep most of your weight in your front heel and your chest up.
Drive through your front foot to bring your back foot forward to standing. Alternate legs.

exercises.name: Lateral Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet together and your toes pointing forward.
Take a big step out to one side and sit your hips back, bending that knee while the other leg stays straight.
Keep your chest up and both feet flat on the floor.
Push off the bent leg to return to the start, then repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: Lateral Lunge (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, or one dumbbell at your chest.
Step out wide to one side and sit your hips back over that foot, keeping the other leg straight.
Lower until your thigh is near parallel, keeping your chest up and your heel down.
Push back to the start and alternate sides.

exercises.name: Curtsy Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg diagonally behind the other, as if curtsying.
Lower until your front thigh is close to parallel with the floor, keeping your hips square.
Push through your front foot to return to standing and alternate sides.

exercises.name: Cossack Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet about twice shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Shift your weight to one side and squat deeply on that leg while the other leg straightens with its toes pointing up.
Keep your heel down and your chest up; hold onto something for balance if needed.
Push back through the middle to the other side and continue alternating.

exercises.name: Knee Push Up
instructions: Kneel on a mat and place your hands on the floor slightly wider than your shoulders.
Walk your hands forward until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your head.
Lower your chest toward the floor, keeping your elbows at about 45 degrees from your body.
Press back up to straight arms without letting your hips sag.

exercises.name: Wall Push Up
instructions: Stand facing a wall at about arm's length and place your hands on it at shoulder height.
Step your feet back a little so you lean toward the wall with your body straight.
Bend your elbows to bring your chest toward the wall.
Push back to the start. Stand closer to the wall to make it easier, or further away to make it harder.

exercises.name: Sissy Squat
instructions: Stand holding a support with one hand and rise onto the balls of your feet.
Bend your knees forward while leaning your torso back, keeping a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Lower as far as you can control, letting your knees travel well past your toes.
Use your quadriceps to return to standing. Go only as deep as your knees tolerate.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull Up (Machine)
instructions: Select the assistance weight; more weight on the stack makes the movement easier.
Kneel or stand on the platform and grip the handles above you.
Pull yourself up until your chin passes the handles, driving your elbows down.
Lower yourself under control to straight arms.

exercises.name: Assisted Dip (Machine)
instructions: Select the assistance weight and kneel or stand on the platform.
Grip the dip handles and press up to straight arms.
Lower yourself by bending your elbows until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back up to the top without locking your elbows hard.

exercises.name: Negative Pull Up
instructions: Use a box or jump to get your chin above the bar with an overhand grip.
Hold the top position with your shoulders pulled down.
Lower yourself as slowly as you can, aiming for three to five seconds, until your arms are straight.
Step back up to the top and repeat.

exercises.name: Pull Up - Wide Grip
instructions: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip clearly wider than your shoulders.
Pull your shoulder blades down, then pull your chest toward the bar.
Get your chin over the bar while keeping your legs still.
Lower yourself to a full hang under control.

exercises.name: Pull Up - Neutral Grip
instructions: Grip the parallel handles of a pull-up station with your palms facing each other.
Hang with straight arms and pull your shoulders down and back.
Pull until your chin clears the handles.
Lower under control to a full hang.

exercises.name: Straight Bar Dip
instructions: Jump to a straight-arm support on top of a single bar with your hands about shoulder-width apart.
Lean your shoulders slightly forward over the bar and let your legs sit a little in front of you for balance.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the bar.
Press back up to straight arms.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and your legs straight.
Brace your core to stop any swinging.
Raise your knees toward your chest, curling your pelvis up at the top.
Lower your legs slowly back to the start.

exercises.name: Windshield Wiper
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar and raise your straight legs until your feet are near the bar.
Keeping your legs together, rotate them down to one side in an arc.
Bring them back through the middle and over to the other side.
Move slowly and keep your upper body as still as you can.

exercises.name: Lying Windshield Wiper
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides, palms down.
Raise your legs straight up so they point at the ceiling, or bend your knees to make it easier.
Lower your legs to one side, stopping just before they touch the floor while your shoulders stay down.
Bring them back to the center and over to the other side.

exercises.name: Pallof Press (Band)
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and stand side-on to the anchor point.
Hold the band with both hands at your chest and step away until there is tension.
Press the band straight out in front of you, resisting the pull that tries to rotate you.
Hold for a moment, bring your hands back to your chest and repeat. Switch sides.

exercises.name: Lateral Walk (Band)
instructions: Place a loop band just above your knees or around your ankles.
Stand with your feet hip-width apart and bend slightly into a quarter squat.
Step sideways with one foot, then follow with the other, keeping tension in the band.
Take the planned number of steps, then walk back the other way. Keep your toes pointing forward.

exercises.name: Face Pull (Band)
instructions: Anchor a band at about head height and hold one end in each hand with your palms facing down.
Step back until the band is taut with your arms straight in front of you.
Pull the band toward your face, separating your hands and bringing your elbows out and back.
Finish with your hands beside your ears, then return slowly.

exercises.name: Triceps Kickback (Cable)
instructions: Set a cable to a low position, hold the handle or cable end in one hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Bring your upper arm alongside your body, parallel to the floor, with your elbow bent.
Straighten your elbow to push the handle back until your arm is fully extended.
Return slowly, keeping your upper arm still. Complete your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Bayesian Curl (Cable)
instructions: Set a cable at a low position and attach a single handle.
Face away from the machine, holding the handle so your arm is pulled slightly behind your body.
Stagger your stance and curl the handle forward and up while keeping your elbow behind your torso.
Lower slowly to a full stretch, then switch arms after your set.

exercises.name: Seated Row (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at chest height and set the chest pad if there is one.
Sit with your chest against the pad and grab the handles with your arms straight.
Pull the handles toward your torso, driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Return the handles slowly until your arms are straight again.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the thigh pads so your legs are held firmly and sit facing the machine.
Grab the handles overhead with your arms straight.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest, driving your elbows down and back.
Let the handles rise slowly until your arms are straight again.

exercises.name: Pendulum Squat (Machine)
instructions: Step into the machine with your back against the pad and your shoulders under the shoulder pads.
Place your feet on the platform about shoulder-width apart and release the safety.
Bend your knees to lower the carriage as deep as you can while keeping your lower back on the pad.
Push through your whole foot to return to the top, and re-engage the safety when you finish.

exercises.name: Belt Squat (Machine)
instructions: Attach the belt around your hips and connect it to the machine's lever arm or cable.
Stand on the platform with your feet about shoulder-width apart and hold the handles for balance.
Squat down by bending your knees and hips while keeping your torso upright.
Drive back up to standing. The load sits on your hips, so your spine is not loaded directly.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Machine)
instructions: Sit in the machine with your upper back against the pad and the belt or pad across your hips.
Place your feet flat on the platform with your knees bent.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso and thighs are in line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower your hips under control.

exercises.name: Glute Kickback (Machine)
instructions: Set up on the machine with your forearms or chest on the pad and one foot on the footplate.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Push the footplate back and up by extending your hip until your thigh is in line with your torso.
Return slowly and complete your reps before switching legs.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine's pivot points.
Sit with your arms against the pads or holding the handles at your sides.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are about shoulder height.
Lower slowly without letting the weight stack rest between reps.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, feet hip-width apart.
With a soft bend in your knees, push your hips back and lower the dumbbells along the front of your legs.
Keep your back flat and stop when you feel a strong stretch in your hamstrings, usually around mid-shin.
Drive your hips forward to stand up tall, squeezing your glutes at the top.

exercises.name: Single Leg Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand on one leg holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand.
Hinge forward at the hip while your free leg extends straight behind you.
Lower the dumbbell toward the floor until your torso and back leg are close to parallel with the floor, keeping your hips square.
Return to standing by driving your hips forward. Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands cupping the top end.
Stand with your feet slightly wider than your shoulders and your toes turned out a little.
Squat down between your knees, keeping your chest up and your elbows inside your knees.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step forward into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor.
Push through your front foot and bring your back leg forward into the next step.
Keep walking forward, alternating legs, with your torso upright.

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry (Dumbbell)
instructions: Pick up a heavy dumbbell or kettlebell in one hand and stand tall.
Brace your core so your shoulders stay level and you do not lean toward the weight.
Walk forward with steady, controlled steps for the planned distance or time.
Set the weight down, switch hands and repeat.

exercises.name: Waiter's Walk (Kettlebell)
instructions: Clean or press a kettlebell overhead in one hand with your arm locked and your bicep near your ear.
Keep your ribs down and your shoulder pulled into its socket.
Walk forward slowly, keeping the kettlebell stacked over your shoulder.
Lower the bell carefully when you finish and repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: Keg Carry
instructions: Lift the keg from the floor to your chest, hugging it tight with your arms wrapped underneath.
Stand tall with the keg high on your chest and lean back slightly to balance it.
Walk quickly with short steps for the required distance.
Lower the keg by squatting down with it rather than dropping it.

exercises.name: Pendlay Row (Barbell)
instructions: Stand over a barbell with your feet hip-width apart and hinge until your torso is close to parallel with the floor.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width with your back flat.
Row the bar explosively to your lower chest without raising your torso.
Return the bar to the floor and let it settle completely before the next rep.

exercises.name: Seal Row (Barbell)
instructions: Lie face down on a raised flat bench with a barbell on the floor or on supports beneath you.
Grip the bar with your arms hanging straight.
Row the bar up toward the underside of the bench, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower it under control to a full stretch. Your chest stays on the bench throughout.

exercises.name: Meadows Row
instructions: Set a barbell in a landmine and stand side-on to the end of the bar in a staggered stance.
Hinge forward, rest your free forearm on your front knee and grab the end of the bar with an overhand grip.
Row the bar up and back toward your hip, letting your elbow travel high.
Lower until your arm is fully straight. Finish the set, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Landmine Press
instructions: Set a barbell in a landmine and hold the end of the bar at your shoulder with one hand.
Stand in a staggered stance, or kneel, with your core braced.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder under control. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Landmine Squat
instructions: Set a barbell in a landmine and hold the end of the bar at your chest with both hands.
Stand facing the anchor with your feet shoulder-width apart, leaning slightly into the bar.
Squat down while keeping your chest up and the bar close.
Drive back up to standing.

exercises.name: Z Press (Barbell)
instructions: Sit on the floor inside a rack with your legs straight out in front of you and the bar set at shoulder height.
Unrack the bar onto your front shoulders while sitting tall without back support.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are locked, keeping your torso upright.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders under control.

exercises.name: Cat Cow
instructions: Start on your hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
Breathe in as you let your belly drop and lift your chest and tailbone (cow).
Breathe out as you round your spine toward the ceiling and tuck your chin and tailbone (cat).
Move slowly between the two positions for the planned number of breaths, staying within a comfortable range.

exercises.name: Open Book Thoracic Rotation
instructions: Lie on your side with your hips and knees bent to 90 degrees and your arms straight out in front of you, palms together.
Keep your knees together and on the floor.
Lift your top arm and rotate your upper back to open it out to the other side, following your hand with your eyes.
Pause where you feel a comfortable stretch, then return. Complete your reps and switch sides.

exercises.name: Thread the Needle
instructions: Start on your hands and knees.
Lift one arm and reach it up toward the ceiling, rotating your chest open.
Sweep that arm down and under your body, threading it between your other hand and knee.
Let your shoulder and the side of your head rest toward the floor for a breath, then reverse. Switch sides after your reps.

exercises.name: 90/90 Hip Switch
instructions: Sit on the floor with both knees bent to about 90 degrees, one leg in front of you and one to the side.
Place your hands behind you for support if needed and sit tall.
Lift both knees and rotate them to the other side so the legs swap positions.
Keep switching sides slowly, staying within a comfortable range.

exercises.name: Couch Stretch
aliases: Rear Foot Elevated Hip Flexor Stretch
instructions: Kneel with your back to a wall or couch and slide one shin up against it so your foot points to the ceiling.
Step your other foot forward into a lunge position with your shin vertical.
Squeeze the glute of the back leg and lift your torso upright until you feel a stretch along the front of the thigh and hip.
Hold, breathing slowly, then switch sides. Pad your knee and back off if it feels too intense.

exercises.name: Knee to Wall Ankle Mobilization
instructions: Stand facing a wall in a half-kneeling or split stance with your front toes a few inches from the wall.
Keeping your front heel on the floor, push your knee forward toward the wall over your middle toes.
Hold briefly at the end of the range, then return.
Move your foot back a little at a time as your range improves. Repeat on both sides.

exercises.name: Wall Slide
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet a few inches in front of it.
Place your elbows and the backs of your hands on the wall at shoulder height, arms bent like goalposts.
Slowly slide your arms up the wall as far as you can while keeping contact and your lower back flat.
Slide back down to the start and repeat.

exercises.name: Scapular Push Up
instructions: Get into a high plank with your arms straight and your body in a line.
Without bending your elbows, let your chest sink so your shoulder blades come together.
Push the floor away to spread your shoulder blades apart and round your upper back slightly.
Move slowly through this small range for the planned reps. Do it from your knees to make it easier.

exercises.name: Dead Hang
instructions: Grab a pull-up bar with an overhand grip about shoulder-width apart.
Lift your feet, or bend your knees, so you hang with your arms fully straight.
Relax your shoulders and let your body lengthen while breathing steadily.
Hold for the planned time, then step down carefully. Keep your feet on a box to take some of the weight.

exercises.name: Foam Roller Thoracic Extension
instructions: Sit on the floor with a foam roller across your back just below your shoulder blades.
Support your head with your hands and lift your hips slightly or keep them on the floor.
Gently extend your upper back over the roller, letting your head and elbows lower toward the floor.
Return to the start, move the roller a little higher and repeat. Avoid rolling into your lower back.

exercises.name: Pigeon Stretch
instructions: Start on your hands and knees and bring one knee forward toward the same-side hand.
Angle that shin across your body and slide your other leg straight back.
Square your hips and lower them toward the floor, supporting yourself on your hands or forearms.
Hold while breathing slowly, then switch sides. Place a cushion under your hip if it does not reach the floor.

exercises.name: Downward Dog
instructions: Start on your hands and knees with your hands slightly in front of your shoulders.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips up and back so your body forms an upside-down V.
Press your chest toward your thighs and reach your heels toward the floor, bending your knees if needed.
Hold while breathing steadily, then lower your knees to rest.

exercises.name: Cobra Stretch
instructions: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders and your legs straight.
Press gently through your hands to lift your chest, keeping your hips on the floor.
Straighten your arms only as far as is comfortable for your lower back.
Hold for a few breaths, then lower down slowly.

exercises.name: Butterfly Stretch
instructions: Sit tall on the floor and bring the soles of your feet together in front of you.
Hold your feet or ankles and let your knees fall out to the sides.
Lean forward from your hips with a long back until you feel a stretch in your inner thighs.
Hold and breathe, letting your knees relax lower over time.

exercises.name: Frog Stretch
instructions: Start on your hands and knees on a padded surface.
Slide your knees out wide with your shins parallel and your ankles in line with your knees.
Lower onto your forearms and gently push your hips back until you feel a stretch in your inner thighs.
Hold or rock slowly forward and back, staying within a comfortable range.

exercises.name: Deep Squat Hold
instructions: Stand with your feet a little wider than your shoulders and your toes turned slightly out.
Squat down as low as you comfortably can, keeping your heels on the floor.
Press your elbows against the inside of your knees and keep your chest up.
Hold while breathing slowly. Hold onto a post or put a small plate under your heels if needed.

exercises.name: Shoulder Pass Through (Band)
instructions: Hold a light band or dowel in front of your hips with a wide overhand grip.
Keeping your arms straight, raise the band up over your head and continue until it reaches your lower back.
Reverse the path to bring it back to the front.
Use a grip wide enough that you can move smoothly without bending your elbows, and narrow it gradually over time.

exercises.name: Sleeper Stretch
instructions: Lie on your side with your bottom arm out in front of you at shoulder height and your elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Use your top hand to gently press your bottom forearm down toward the floor.
Stop when you feel a mild stretch at the back of the shoulder, not a pinch at the front.
Hold for a few breaths, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Doorway Pec Stretch
instructions: Stand in a doorway and place your forearms on the door frame with your elbows at about shoulder height.
Step one foot through the doorway.
Lean gently forward until you feel a stretch across your chest and the front of your shoulders.
Hold while breathing slowly, then step back out.

exercises.name: Standing Quad Stretch
instructions: Stand tall next to a wall or chair for balance.
Bend one knee and hold that foot behind you with the same-side hand.
Keep your knees close together and gently tuck your pelvis until you feel a stretch along the front of your thigh.
Hold, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Clamshell
instructions: Lie on your side with your hips and knees bent and your feet together, resting your head on your arm.
Stack your hips so your top hip is directly over the bottom one.
Keeping your feet touching, lift your top knee as far as you can without rolling your hips back.
Lower slowly. Complete your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Clamshell (Band)
instructions: Place a loop band just above your knees and lie on your side with your hips and knees bent.
Keep your feet together and your hips stacked.
Open your top knee against the band without letting your pelvis roll back.
Close slowly against the band's pull. Switch sides after your reps.

exercises.name: Side Lying Leg Raise
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs straight and stacked, bending the bottom knee slightly for balance if you like.
Keep your top toes pointing forward rather than up.
Lift your top leg toward the ceiling to a comfortable height without rolling your hips back.
Lower slowly, complete your reps and switch sides.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
instructions: Start on your hands and knees with your back flat and your neck neutral.
Brace your core lightly as if preparing for a gentle push in the stomach.
Slowly reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are in line with your torso.
Pause without letting your hips tilt, then return and switch sides.

exercises.name: Heel Slide
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Slowly slide one heel along the floor toward your buttocks, bending your knee as far as is comfortable.
Pause briefly, then slide the heel back out until the leg is straight.
Repeat for the planned reps and switch legs. A towel under the heel can help it glide.

exercises.name: Quad Set
instructions: Sit or lie with your leg straight, placing a small rolled towel under the knee if you like.
Tighten the muscle on the front of your thigh to press the back of your knee down toward the floor.
Hold the squeeze for a few seconds while breathing normally.
Relax fully, then repeat.

exercises.name: Straight Leg Raise
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and that foot flat, and the other leg straight.
Tighten the thigh of the straight leg so the knee stays locked.
Lift the straight leg until it is level with the bent knee.
Lower slowly, complete your reps and switch sides.

exercises.name: Terminal Knee Extension (Band)
instructions: Anchor a loop band at knee height and step into it so it sits behind one knee.
Step back until there is tension, with that knee slightly bent and your heel on the floor.
Straighten the knee fully against the band by squeezing your thigh.
Slowly let the knee bend again. Complete your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Wall Sit
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet about two feet in front of it.
Slide down the wall until your knees are bent, up to about 90 degrees or less if that is more comfortable.
Keep your knees over your ankles and your back flat on the wall.
Hold for the planned time, then slide back up to standing.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit on a chair with your feet flat and your knees bent to about 90 degrees.
Rest your hands on your thighs, adding gentle pressure or a weight for more challenge.
Lift your heels as high as you can, pressing through the balls of your feet.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.

exercises.name: Tibialis Raise
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and your heels about a foot in front of it.
Keep your legs straight and lean your back on the wall.
Lift your toes and the front of your feet as high as you can toward your shins.
Lower slowly without letting your toes slap down. Step your feet further out to make it harder.

exercises.name: Chin Tuck
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and your eyes looking straight ahead.
Gently glide your head straight back, as if making a double chin, without tilting it up or down.
Hold for a few seconds while breathing normally.
Release back to neutral and repeat.

exercises.name: Y-T-W Raise
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench or the floor with your arms hanging or resting by your head, thumbs up.
Raise your arms overhead into a Y shape, squeezing your shoulder blades, then lower.
Raise your arms straight out to the sides into a T, then lower.
Bend your elbows and pull them down and back into a W, then lower. Use light dumbbells only once this feels easy.

exercises.name: Copenhagen Plank
instructions: Lie on your side next to a bench and prop yourself up on your forearm with your elbow under your shoulder.
Rest the inside of your top knee on the bench; this short-lever version is the starting point.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line, letting the bottom leg hang or lift toward the bench.
Hold for a short time, lower gently and switch sides.
Progress to resting the inner foot and ankle on the bench only when the knee version feels easy.

exercises.name: Step Up
instructions: Stand facing a low, stable step or box.
Place one whole foot on the step.
Press through that foot to step up, bringing the other foot to meet it, then stand tall.
Step back down with control, leading with the same leg. Use a rail for balance if needed.

exercises.name: Sit to Stand
instructions: Sit toward the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat and about hip-width apart.
Lean your chest forward slightly over your knees.
Press through your feet to stand up fully, using your hands on your thighs or the armrests if needed.
Sit back down slowly and with control.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge March
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat, hip-width apart.
Lift your hips into a bridge so your body forms a line from shoulders to knees.
Keeping your hips level, lift one foot a few inches off the floor, then set it down.
Alternate legs while holding the bridge, then lower your hips slowly.

exercises.name: Pelvic Tilt
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Gently tighten your stomach and flatten your lower back against the floor by tilting your pelvis.
Hold for a few seconds while breathing normally.
Relax back to a neutral position and repeat.

exercises.name: Single Leg Balance
instructions: Stand next to a wall or sturdy chair for safety.
Shift your weight onto one foot and lift the other foot slightly off the floor.
Keep your standing knee soft and your hips level while you hold the position.
Hold for the planned time and switch legs. Close your eyes or stand on a cushion to make it harder.

exercises.name: Kneeling Side Plank
instructions: Lie on your side propped on your forearm with your elbow under your shoulder and your knees bent behind you.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from your knees to your head.
Keep your hips stacked and avoid rolling forward or back.
Hold, lower down and switch sides.

exercises.name: Side Plank Hip Dip
instructions: Get into a side plank on your forearm with your feet stacked.
Lower your hips toward the floor without touching it.
Lift your hips back up past the starting line by squeezing your side.
Repeat for the planned reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Side Plank Reach Through
instructions: Hold a side plank on your forearm with your top arm reaching to the ceiling.
Rotate your chest toward the floor and reach your top arm under your body.
Rotate back open and reach the arm up again.
Keep your hips lifted the whole time, then switch sides.

exercises.name: High Plank
instructions: Place your hands under your shoulders and step your feet back into the top of a push-up.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels, squeezing your glutes and bracing your core.
Push the floor away so your upper back does not sag.
Hold for the planned time while breathing steadily.

exercises.name: Plank Shoulder Tap
instructions: Start in a high plank with your feet a little wider than your hips.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Place the hand back down and tap with the other hand.
Keep your hips as still as possible; widen your feet to make it easier.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Raise
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands by your sides or under your hips.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise your legs together until they point toward the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping before your lower back lifts off the floor.

exercises.name: Decline Sit Up
instructions: Secure your feet under the pads of a decline bench and lie back.
Cross your arms over your chest or place your fingertips by your ears.
Curl your torso up until it is upright.
Lower back down slowly under control.

exercises.name: Pause Squat (Barbell)
instructions: Set up as for a back squat with the bar across your upper back.
Squat down to your normal depth.
Hold the bottom position for one to three seconds while staying tight and keeping your chest up.
Drive back up without bouncing. Use a lighter load than for normal squats.

exercises.name: Pin Squat (Barbell)
instructions: Set the safety pins in a power rack at or just above your bottom squat depth.
Squat down until the bar settles on the pins, releasing the tension briefly while staying braced.
Drive the bar up off the pins to standing.
Alternatively, start each rep from the pins with the bar resting on them.

exercises.name: Low Bar Squat (Barbell)
instructions: Place the bar on your rear shoulders just below the bony ridge of your shoulder blades, with a fairly narrow grip.
Walk it out and set your feet about shoulder-width apart with your toes turned out.
Sit your hips back and down with a slightly greater forward lean than a high-bar squat until your hips pass below your knees.
Drive your hips up and back to standing, keeping the bar over the middle of your feet.

exercises.name: Block Pull (Barbell)
instructions: Place the plates of a loaded barbell on blocks or mats so the bar starts around knee height or just below.
Set up as for a deadlift with your shins close to the bar and your back flat.
Drive through your legs and hips to stand up with the bar, locking out your hips and knees together.
Lower the bar back onto the blocks under control.

exercises.name: Paused Bench Press (Barbell)
instructions: Set up on the bench as for a normal bench press with your shoulder blades pulled back.
Lower the bar to your chest under control.
Hold it motionless on your chest for one to two seconds, as in competition.
Press the bar back up to locked arms.

exercises.name: Spoto Press (Barbell)
instructions: Set up on the bench as for a normal bench press.
Lower the bar under control and stop it about an inch above your chest.
Hold it there for a moment without touching your chest or losing tightness.
Press back up to locked arms.
